items.reason: The record plans 'Biomarker correlation (EGFR expression, ROS levels) with SDT response using multiplex IHC and RNA sequencing', and ROS is the candidate's stated mechanism ('activate the sonosensitizer Hiporfin® ... generating cytotoxic reactive oxygen species (ROS)'). Because the biomarker is linked to the candidate's mechanism, 'unclear' (biomarker not linked to the candidate) does not fit; but no pre/post sampling or pharmacodynamic objective is stated, so ROS could be a baseline correlate, which would make it 'no'.

note: Harmonisation (B7 clarification) undoes the D31-B7 change: bevacizumab, temozolomide and radiotherapy are soc_backbone (registered 'Standard Treatment' in both arms); hematoporphyrin (device_dependent, sonodynamic therapy) is the only candidate, experimental_monotherapy; regimen combination; has_eligible_candidate true. Still needs XL: target_engagement_planned (yes vs no, low confidence). The record plans an exploratory 'Biomarker correlation (EGFR expression, ROS levels) with SDT response' by IHC/RNA-seq but states no PD objective or pre/post sampling, so D31-C6 does not settle it.

revisions.reason: Bevacizumab 7.5-10 mg/kg q3w is given identically in both arms of a newly diagnosed trial while SDT is randomised; it is not established standard care for newly diagnosed GBM, so it stays a candidate.
With bevacizumab a co-candidate in the experimental arm, hematoporphyrin is one of two investigational agents (manual rule 5).

harmonisation.reason: Bevacizumab is an established GBM drug given identically in both arms as part of the registered standard therapy, so under the B7 clarification and manual rule 3/rule 6 (D30-R1) it is soc_backbone, never a candidate.

With bevacizumab back as backbone, hematoporphyrin (device-activated by sonodynamic ultrasound) is the only investigational agent (manual rule 4); has_eligible_candidate stays true and regimen stays combination (RT, temozolomide, bevacizumab).
